## Tested environment

- **OS / host**: Windows 11 / REAPER 7.80 (AVI/MJPEG writing and playback checked without FFmpeg)
- **Test hardware**: Akai APC40 mkII (real hardware), Reloop Buddy (MIDI mapping checked on real hardware; Windows needs the driver), Pioneer DDJ-FLX4 (tested on real hardware only early in development, not with current features (channel faders, headphone CUE button, tempo fader direction and so on); treated as untested like the other models until it is tested again), AlphaTheta DDJ-FLX2 (settings based on the official MIDI message list; not yet tested on the real hardware)
- **Other controllers**: not tested on the real hardware, including the NI Traktor Kontrol models connected over HID (marked as untested in the [“Preset list”](controller-setup-and-midi-mapping.md#preset-list)).
- **macOS**: an early version (2026-10-03) was checked on macOS (REAPER 7.47) by a test user. Features added since (deck B, video blending, the HID bridge and so on) have not been checked on macOS. Linux has not been tried. If something goes wrong, please let us know.
